criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Rendered and inside the register; 1, 2, 4 and 7 bold at true scale. 8's cover covers only the front with a sawtooth hem over a four-door crossover with mirror stubs; 6 reads as a UI widget; 5's crate, lamp and tape read as primitives; 9 is the greyest frame; 1's wall stops short of the right edge.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Plainly one deck with two working continuity devices; 6 sits outside; the value arc is not felt; same skeleton on nine frames.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace and the Texas label rows are handled honestly; the caption's 'made in California' overreaches c27; frame 3's three times is a ratio of floors; frame 8 draws mirror stubs against c42 without 'drawn to illustrate'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The cover's 'rows' assume the reader knows the table; no slide names the document; no county, deadline or concrete Texas stake; the caption closes on a question.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays, 3 makes the ratio visible, 5 turns, 9 lands; 6 is a detour; 4 restates Production.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; table-speak ('row', 'label'); no regional specificity.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic; the close repeats no. 56's taped bays beside lit machines three days on; floodlit world ran no. 55.

one_sentence_fix: Name the instrument and place in plain words on the cover and in the caption's first lines.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A skirt over the hood with a sawtooth hem; rear half an uncovered four-door crossover with mirror stubs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drape the whole body in one lofted cloth with smoothed hem vertices over a two-door short body, mirror geometry deleted.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bordered tray in black with a flat bar (cast fraction 0.041).
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Plate bleeds off the frame; groove milled with a lit upper and shadowed lower wall, tape at its floor.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Greyest frame; flat wall; blob lamp shadows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Wall face toward the camera into shadow, lamp heads and bays bright, PCSS lamp casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Crate a plain box, lamp head a flat rectangle, tape a flat fill.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Strapped crate, lamp on so its pool rakes the crate and far pad.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Wall stops short of the right edge; bay interiors a brown wash.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Yaw so the wall runs off the right; drop bay back walls toward black.
